about: Conformance corpus (DC-001-08). `valid` = accepted by the full pipeline (loader, schema, validate); tags: loader (rejected by load_json/load_yaml), conditional (an if/then/else rule of the schema), post-schema (rejected by validate beyond the JSON Schema), cross-file (rejected by tools/check_contracts.py only). `pointer`/`keyword` = expected error (draft examples: some error of the reference validator, nested ones included).
